targets.rawSql: SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", "ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY "DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY a."DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY a."DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT now() AS "time", AVG(ABS(f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]")) - AVG(ABS(f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]")) AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval), metric, AVG(value) AS "value" FROM (SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Actual' AS metric, a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a WHERE a."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND a."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' UNION ALL SELECT f."DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Day-ahead Forecast' AS metric, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f WHERE f."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND f."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND f."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND f."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND f."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' UNION ALL SELECT f."DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Current Forecast' AS metric, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f WHERE f."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND f."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND f."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND f."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND f."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type') s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH joined AS (SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS current_error_mw, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS day_ahead_error_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND a."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)), prices AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS price_mwh FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), metric, AVG(value) AS "value" FROM (SELECT ts, 'Current Error' AS metric, current_error_mw AS value FROM joined UNION ALL SELECT ts, 'Day-ahead Error' AS metric, day_ahead_error_mw AS value FROM joined UNION ALL SELECT ts, 'Day-ahead Price' AS metric, price_mwh AS value FROM prices) s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH joined AS (SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS current_error_mw, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS day_ahead_error_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND a."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) SELECT day AS "time", metric, value FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, 'Current MAE' AS metric, AVG(ABS(current_error_mw)) AS value FROM joined GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, 'Day-ahead MAE' AS metric, AVG(ABS(day_ahead_error_mw)) AS value FROM joined GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, 'Correction Magnitude' AS metric, AVG(ABS(current_error_mw - day_ahead_error_mw)) AS value FROM joined GROUP BY 1) s ORDER BY 1

WITH joined AS (SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS actual_mw, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS current_error_mw, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS day_ahead_error_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND a."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts)::int AS hour_utc, ROUND(AVG(actual_mw)::numeric, 1) AS avg_actual_mw, ROUND(AVG(ABS(day_ahead_error_mw))::numeric, 1) AS avg_abs_day_ahead_error_mw, ROUND(AVG(ABS(current_error_mw))::numeric, 1) AS avg_abs_current_error_mw, ROUND(AVG(day_ahead_error_mw)::numeric, 1) AS avg_day_ahead_bias_mw, ROUND(AVG(current_error_mw)::numeric, 1) AS avg_current_bias_mw FROM joined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH val_map (grafana_label, db_name) AS (VALUES ('Albania (AL)', 'Albania'), ('Austria (AT)', 'Austria'), ('Belgium (BE)', 'Belgium'), ('Bosnia and Herz. (BA)', 'Bosnia and Herzegovina'), ('Bulgaria (BG)', 'Bulgaria'), ('Croatia (HR)', 'Croatia'), ('Cyprus (CY)', 'Cyprus'), ('Czech Republic (CZ)', 'Czechia'), ('Denmark (DK)', 'Denmark'), ('DK', 'Denmark'), ('DK1', 'Denmark'), ('DK2', 'Denmark'), ('Estonia (EE)', 'Estonia'), ('Finland (FI)', 'Finland'), ('France (FR)', 'France'), ('Germany (DE)', 'Germany'), ('DE(50Hertz)', 'Germany'), ('DE(Amprion)', 'Germany'), ('DE(TenneT GER)', 'Germany'), ('DE(TransnetBW)', 'Germany'), ('DE-LU', 'Germany'), ('Greece (GR)', 'Greece'), ('Hungary (HU)', 'Hungary'), ('Ireland (IE)', 'Ireland'), ('IE(SEM)', 'Ireland'), ('Italy (IT)', 'Italy'), ('IT-Calabria', 'Italy'), ('IT-Centre-North', 'Italy'), ('IT-Centre-South', 'Italy'), ('IT-North', 'Italy'), ('IT-Sardinia', 'Italy'), ('IT-Sicily', 'Italy'), ('IT-South', 'Italy'), ('Kosovo (XK)', 'Kosovo'), ('Latvia (LV)', 'Latvia'), ('Lithuania (LT)', 'Lithuania'), ('Luxembourg (LU)', 'Luxembourg'), ('Moldova (MD)', 'Moldova'), ('Montenegro (ME)', 'Montenegro'), ('Netherlands (NL)', 'Netherlands'), ('North Macedonia (MK)', 'North Macedonia'), ('Norway (NO)', 'Norway'), ('NO1', 'Norway'), ('NO2', 'Norway'), ('NO3', 'Norway'), ('NO4', 'Norway'), ('NO5', 'Norway'), ('Poland (PL)', 'Poland'), ('Portugal (PT)', 'Portugal'), ('Romania (RO)', 'Romania'), ('Serbia (RS)', 'Serbia'), ('Slovakia (SK)', 'Slovakia'), ('Slovenia (SI)', 'Slovenia'), ('Spain (ES)', 'Spain'), ('Sweden (SE)', 'Sweden'), ('SE1', 'Sweden'), ('SE2', 'Sweden'), ('SE3', 'Sweden'), ('SE4', 'Sweden'), ('Switzerland (CH)', 'Switzerland'), ('United Kingdom (UK)', 'United Kingdom'), ('GB', 'United Kingdom'), ('Ukraine (UA)', 'Ukraine')), latest_joined AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (a."AreaDisplayName") a."AreaDisplayName" AS area_name, a."DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS current_error_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY a."AreaDisplayName", a."DateTime(UTC)" DESC), country_centroids AS (SELECT country AS db_name, AVG(lat) AS lat, AVG(lon) AS lon FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata WHERE lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country), country_errors AS (SELECT vm.db_name, AVG(lj.current_error_mw) AS current_error_mw, AVG(ABS(lj.current_error_mw)) AS abs_current_error_mw, MAX(lj.ts) AS snapshot_time, COUNT(*) AS bidding_zones FROM latest_joined lj JOIN val_map vm ON vm.grafana_label = lj.area_name GROUP BY vm.db_name) SELECT 0 AS "time", cc.lat, cc.lon, ce.db_name AS name, ce.db_name AS country, ROUND(ce.current_error_mw::numeric, 1) AS current_error_mw, ROUND(ce.abs_current_error_mw::numeric, 1) AS abs_current_error_mw, ce.bidding_zones, ce.snapshot_time FROM country_errors ce JOIN country_centroids cc ON cc.db_name = ce.db_name ORDER BY ce.abs_current_error_mw DESC

WITH joined AS (SELECT a."DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS actual_mw, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" AS current_fc_mw, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" AS day_ahead_fc_mw, f."CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS current_error_mw, f."DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" - a."ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS day_ahead_error_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" a JOIN entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" f ON f."DateTime(UTC)" = a."DateTime(UTC)" AND f."AreaDisplayName" = a."AreaDisplayName" AND f."AreaTypeCode" = a."AreaTypeCode" AND f."ProductionType" = a."ProductionType" WHERE a."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND a."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND a."ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' AND a."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND a."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)), prices AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS price_mwh FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) SELECT j.ts AS forecast_time, ROUND(j.actual_mw::numeric, 1) AS actual_mw, ROUND(j.day_ahead_fc_mw::numeric, 1) AS day_ahead_fc_mw, ROUND(j.current_fc_mw::numeric, 1) AS current_fc_mw, ROUND(j.day_ahead_error_mw::numeric, 1) AS day_ahead_error_mw, ROUND(j.current_error_mw::numeric, 1) AS current_error_mw, ROUND(ABS(j.current_error_mw)::numeric, 1) AS abs_current_error_mw, ROUND(p.price_mwh::numeric, 2) AS price_eur_mwh FROM joined j LEFT JOIN prices p ON p.ts = j.ts ORDER BY abs_current_error_mw DESC, forecast_time DESC LIMIT 25
